chapter_mission: Deliver the book's First Plot Point — the Galactic Alliance commits to garrisoning Corellian space, which locks both sides into a war posture. Jedi Council factional lines harden; Jacen's activism hardens with them.
chapter_turn: The crisis crosses from negotiation into deployment — the Alliance will now put fleet elements over Corellia, and the Order will be asked whose side it is on.

scene_plan.purpose: Jedi Council session — Corran Horn against Order complicity; Luke holds; Alliance announces garrison posture.
Jacen alone post-session — interior commitment that the Order's neutrality is morally inadequate.

exit_vector: Jacen alone in a training room after the Council session, privately certain the Order's neutrality is inadequate.
notes: First Plot Point. The Alliance's deployment decision is Han's lock-in on the other direction as well.
